visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman walk past a large wall featuring red and green Heineken graphics. The man waves enthusiastically at the camera. He wears a beige hoodie and olive pants, while the woman wears a pink jacket and shorts. The environment is bright and spacious with a clean floor. (2) They move into an indoor shop area. The woman walks down stairs while carrying a clear water bottle. The background shows wooden shelves filled with green merchandise and interactive digital displays. Other shoppers are visible in the background, including several staff members in formal suits. (3) The man holds a green sweatshirt with a Heineken logo in front of a rack of similar clothing. He points at it with a surprised expression. The lighting is warm and comes from ceiling fixtures. Behind him, more racks of clothing and various green apparel items are visible. (4) A boxed Heineken glass is shown in a close-up. The man holds it near his face, looking directly at the camera with wide eyes. A visual distortion filter is briefly applied to his face for a comedic effect, enlarging his eyes and mouth significantly. (5) The man displays a patterned green raincoat featuring beer icons and red stars. He holds it up with both hands, showing the design details. The background is a white tiled wall. Cardboard tags are clearly visible on the sleeve of the garment he is holding. (6) A montage of store displays follows. Shelves contain rows of Heineken t-shirts, green caps, and tote bags. A large metal tub is filled with socks and keychains. The camera pans quickly over various sections, highlighting the dense concentration of brand-themed merchandise. (7) The camera focuses on green rubber bar mats on a wooden surface. Next, shelves with playing cards, candles, and laptop bags are shown. The woman is seen picking up a long, flat wooden cheese board from a wall display of kitchen-related items. (8) The final scene shows the couple returning to the graphic wall from the beginning. They both wave joyfully toward the camera as they walk out of the frame. The lighting remains bright and the background remains a consistent large-scale graphic print.
